# K_7 has 7 vertices, 21 edges
# Edge indices in lexicographic order of (i,j) for i<j

def edge_index(i, j):
    if i > j:
        i, j = j, i
    # edges before (i,j): for k from 0 to i-1, edges (k, k+1) to (k, 6)
    # that's sum_{k=0}^{i-1} (6-k) = 7*i - i*(i+1)/2
    # plus edges (i, i+1) to (i, j-1) = j-i-1
    idx = 7*i - i*(i+1)//2 + (j - i - 1)
    return idx

# We have 21 boolean variables, one per edge

# c[13]=0 (red), so edge 13 is red -> variable 14 is True

formula.append([9])

# c[13]=0 (red): edge 13 is red, so variable 14 is True -> clause [14]
formula.append([14])

formula.append([-15])

    # At least one of these is blue (variable is False), so at least one is negated
    formula.append([-e1, -e2, -e3])
